title: SecOps-NG Risk-Analysis Evidence Artifact
description: Typed shape for one evidence artifact emitted by the risk-analysis evidence stream (F-CP-01). One artifact is produced per (control, cadence) pair; downstream consumers (kri.control_effectiveness@v1, the F-CP-06 effectiveness-loop stream, executive-metrics rollups) read these as the operator-side source of truth for how a risk-management control is performing against its declared review cadence. Public-bar artifact: operator-side strings (policy versions, owner labels) MUST stay role-shaped (mailbox, working-group, role title); individual names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. Lets a consumer reject artifacts produced under an older schema once breaking changes ship.

artifact_id.description: Stable per-artifact identifier. Convention: SHA-256 hex digest of `<control_stable_id>|<captured_at>` (UTF-8, no separators around the pipe). Deterministic on those two inputs so a replay re-derives the same id.

stream.description: Identifies which evidence stream produced the artifact. Constant on this schema.

control_ref.description: Stable-id reference to the control attested by this artifact. Long-form URN; same shape every other layer of the content model uses.

regulation_refs.description: Pins to the upstream regulatory mapping entries this artifact helps satisfy (e.g. nis2:art-21-2-a, dora:art-5-governance, dora:art-6-framework). At least one entry — an artifact with no regulatory anchor is not evidence in the F-CP-01 sense. Joins back into content/mappings/<regime>/*.yaml via the `id` field.

policy_version.description: Version pointer for the operator's policy document at the moment of attestation. Either a SemVer string (preferred when the operator maintains policies under version control) or a 64-character lowercase hex content-hash. Free-text policy titles MUST NOT be used here — the human title goes in the risk_analysis_output narrative.

attestation_state.description: Most recent attestation state for the referenced control. Imports the shared four-state vocabulary from schemas/attestation_state.json so the stream, kri.control_effectiveness@v1, and the F-CP-06 effectiveness-loop stream agree on the enum.

attestation_state_delta.description: Optional transition from the immediately previous artifact in the same control_ref series. Omitted on the first emission for a control. Required by F-CP-06 once a prior artifact exists; the emitter is responsible for the lookup.

risk_analysis_output.description: Operator-side analysis narrative for this cadence. Free-form structured block so a reviewer can read the residual-exposure rationale, scoped scenarios, and any deviations from baseline. Fields here are intended to be filled in by a workflow step (often via a DSPy signature, per the F-WF-01 / F-WF-03 precedent for free-text fields); the deterministic state fields above stay code.

residual_exposure_summary.description: One-paragraph plain-language summary of the residual exposure remaining after the control's most-recent attestation. Public-bar text: no operator branding, no individual names.

scoped_scenarios.description: Optional list of risk scenarios the cadence's review explicitly considered, each named in plain text.

deviations_from_baseline.description: Optional list of points where the operator's scoped variant diverges from the community baseline this artifact references.

compensating_controls.description: Optional list of control stable-ids the operator is relying on to compensate for any partially_effective / ineffective state on the primary control_ref. Compensating-control credit is NOT consumed by kri.control_effectiveness@v1 itself (which is a pre-credit indicator) — this list documents the operator's rationale for a reviewer.

owner.description: Dated ownership pointer required by NIS2 Art. 21(2)(a). Role-shaped — a working-group mailbox, a generic role title, or a community handle. Individual personal names are out of scope per AGENTS.md §3 and rejected here as a matter of schema discipline.

role.description: Generic role or working-group identifier (e.g. 'risk-management-wg@example.org', 'security-officer', 'governance-board'). Personal names are not used.

assigned_at.description: ISO-8601 date on which the role was assigned ownership of this control.

review_cadence.description: Re-assessment cadence the artifact was produced under. ISO-8601 duration. Normally copied from the control_ref's `review_cadence` field; an artifact MAY carry a tighter cadence when the operator runs a scoped variant.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which this attestation was captured. Stable input to artifact_id.

provenance.description: Where this artifact came from. Mirrors the provenance pattern used by content/controls/*.yaml so a reviewer can re-derive the chain back to source.

source_url.description: URL of the workflow run (or workflow-content source) that produced this artifact. Compile targets may use their own run-id URLs; the URL itself is opaque to this schema.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 date or date-time matching the artifact-level captured_at.

commit_sha.description: Optional commit SHA of the content snapshot the workflow walked.

baseline_drift.description: Optional drift signal. Set by the emitter when the upstream regulatory text or OSCAL catalog version pinned on the previous artifact has changed since the previous emission. Consumed by the F-CP-01 DRIFT card's downstream alert hook (separate card; this field reserves the shape).
